container-hotel.name: Container Hotel
container-hotel.sourceSheet: Platform Common Specs (SSOT v2 gap-fill 08Aug2026) - slug container-hotel

specifications.detail: 150×75×5 mm MS C-channel
100×50×4 mm channels and room/bathroom support members
100×50×3 mm primary and 80×40×3 mm secondary floor members
80×40×3 mm MS top frame
60×40×2.5 mm roof members
60×60×3 mm corner posts with partition and façade supports
Designed MS lifting hooks or lugs matched to the completed unit weight; handle only by the approved lifting and support-point drawing.
Welded MS fabrication with cleaned joints, safe edges, dimensional inspection and coating touch-up before panel closure and dispatch.
1.25–1.6 mm corrugated MS structural sheet with HPL/WPC/wood-finish over-cladding
1.6 mm corrugated MS sheet
12 mm plywood with laminate/HPL; fibre-cement and tiles in bathroom zones
12.5 mm gypsum or decorative laminated ceiling
19 mm marine plywood and cement board in wet areas
5–6 mm SPC/engineered wood plus anti-skid bathroom tile
75 mm mineral wool
100 mm mineral wool
Premium HPL/WPC/wooden-finish metal façade with coordinated hotel-grade interior laminate.
Security grill, insect mesh, guard, louver or protection selected only where the approved use and opening schedule requires it.
Premium room door with closer plus waterproof bathroom door where included.
Large aluminium windows with 6 mm tinted glass and optional blinds.
Security grill, insect mesh, guard, louver or protection selected only where the approved use and opening schedule requires it.
Concealed PVC-insulated copper wiring, typically 1.5 sq.mm lighting, 2.5 sq.mm sockets and 4 sq.mm higher-load or AC circuits, subject to the final load schedule.
Distribution board with MCB/RCCB protection, earthing and segregation of lighting, socket, wet-area and AC circuits according to the approved electrical drawing.
Room LED lighting, bedside sockets, data/TV points, geyser point and dedicated AC circuit.
Split-AC provision, bathroom exhaust and optional fresh-air system.
Attached bathroom with WC, shower, basin, CPVC/UPVC services and floor drains where ordered.
Guest-room layout with sleeping, storage and optional bathroom zones.
One red-oxide primer coat followed by two compatible anti-rust enamel coats on prepared MS surfaces; project exposure may require an upgraded coating system.
Pre-dispatch checks cover dimensions, member and sheet identification, welds, coating, roof drainage, weather sealing, doors, windows, electrical continuity and functional operation.

5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard; finishing warranty extendable to 2 years on request, confirmed at quotation. Relocation damage, misuse, site services and unapproved alterations remain outside the agreed scope unless stated otherwise.

container-coffee-shop.sourceSheet: L16-3 exempt class - section 5 of the 08 Aug draft of record

summary.detail: Standard container cafe shell. See the full specification on the container cafe hub.
Dedicated equipment circuits on the approved load schedule, separate from lighting and general sockets.
Treated water feed positioned for the machine, with isolation at the counter run.
Waste and drainage taken below the counter line, out of the customer view.
Glazed counter face for pastry, bean and merchandise display.

5-year structural warranty and 1-year finishing warranty as standard; finishing warranty extendable to 2 years on request, confirmed at quotation. Relocation damage, misuse, site services and unapproved alterations remain outside the agreed scope unless stated otherwise.
